description_en: Queries for one or more SAP HANA backup plans that match specified criteria
description_zh: 获取一个或者多个符合条件的 SAP HANA 备份计划
kebab_example: aliyun hbr describe-hana-backup-plans --vault-id v-000i4lg4kz000000ahl --cluster-id cl-000chxz000000lz7bk --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --database-name SYSTEMDB --resource-group-id rg-acfmvywqfey5njq --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHanaBackupPlans

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup vault
parameters.name: vault_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the SAP HANA instance
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be a number that starts from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页页码。从1开始，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 99. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小。最小值为1，最大值为99，默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id
